# Niveditha S Wall Artistry

> Niveditha S is a professional wall muralist based in India, creating bespoke 100% freehand hand-painted murals for residential homes, commercial cafes, offices, and accent spaces.

## About Niveditha S
Niveditha S is a passionate visual artist who specializes in large-scale wall murals. Unlike digital or stencil-based wall art, every mural she creates is sketched and painted completely freehand on the wall — no projectors, no decals, no transfers. She tailors each design to the unique geometry, lighting, and personality of the client's space.

## Services & Pricing
Niveditha S offers three tiers of custom wall mural services:
- **Minimalist Murals** (line art, botanical outlines): ₹80 per sq.ft
- **Detailed Murals** (full floral, rich shading): ₹150 per sq.ft
- **Narrative / Character Murals** (Harry Potter, fantasy, custom scenes): ₹350 per sq.ft

All prices include design consultation, custom sketch, raw materials, and on-site mural execution.

## Portfolio Highlights
1. **Harry Potter Wizards Sanctuary** — Residential bedroom mural with magical dimensions and wizarding details
2. **Botanical Basin Accent** — Elegant hand-painted leaves and vines framing a washbasin wall
3. **Whispering Meadow** — Minimal floral linework for a living room space
4. **Bespoke Lobby Masterpiece** — Large-scale commercial statement wall for a lobby
5. **Cozy Study Vignette** — Character mural for a children's reading nook or bedroom

## What Makes Niveditha S Unique
- 100% freehand — no projectors, no decals, no stencils, no transfers
- Custom concept sketches prepared and approved before every project
- Designs adapted to wall geometry, room lighting, and furniture context
- Covers residential (living rooms, bedrooms, nurseries), accent (washbasins, dining rooms), and commercial (cafes, offices, lobbies, gyms) spaces
- Eco-friendly paint materials

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How much does a wall mural cost in India?**
A: Minimalist murals start from ₹80/sq.ft, detailed floral murals are ₹150/sq.ft, and narrative/character murals cost ₹350/sq.ft.

**Q: Are the murals hand-painted or done with projectors?**
A: Every mural is 100% freehand — no projectors, stencils, or decals are ever used.

**Q: How long does a wall mural take?**
A: Small accent walls: 1–2 days. Large detailed or narrative murals: 3–7 days.

**Q: What spaces can get a wall mural?**
A: Any flat wall surface — living rooms, bedrooms, nurseries, washbasins, dining rooms, cafes, offices, hotel lobbies, gyms, and retail stores.

**Q: How do I commission a mural?**
A: Contact via nivisun4@gmail.com or WhatsApp +91 86672 10067.
